text: Even the commander of the gods… is a small child in mother's lap!
He is the warrior who slayed Tarakasura, the commander of the gods.
As his mother, we worship Goddess Parvati as Skandamata.
In this form, the Goddess has four hands.
Holding lotuses in two hands, embracing Balaskanda with one hand, and granting fearlessness to devotees with another hand.
See how beautiful the sentiment is in this form…
Seated on a lion vehicle is the great power that protects the world.
And in mother's lap, a refuge for a small child.
Embracing her child with one hand…
With the other hand, she is also giving assurance to devotees.
That is why, when we behold this form, along with the Goddess's power, mother's love also comes close to us.
It is not just calling Shakti as mother…
It is also the form that sees divinity in mother's love — Skandamata.
